event: They wait in the dark at the foot of the broken stair; Alan listens with the sense.
He feels two men coming down, annoyed rather than alarmed.
Tygryth and the girl kill them both in the dark, all but silently.
Wren: they were sent to see why the dock went quiet; soon someone up there will know.
Tygryth bids Alan lead them up quickly, the one who sees in the dark now.
The stair climbs into a vast half-flooded hall broken by stubs of fallen columns.

event: The girl steps toward the water, pulled down toward her blood beneath the floor.
Alan stops her: up first, remove the threat, then free the one who is threatened.
She demands his word that they come back down for him.
Alan gives it: they will set him free.
